entries.note: REPLACEMENT for the dead Navigating-UI3 fallback article (help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/23954856027159-Navigating-UI3 confirmed HTTP 404 on 2026-07-28). This live article ('Figma Design > Tour the interface > Explore') covers the same UI3 overview ground: toolbar/nav-bar/sidebars/canvas diagram (explore-design-file-annotation.png, labels A-E) plus dedicated left-navbar.png and left-sidebar.png crops. left-navbar.png confirms the icon rail is unchanged since the 2026-07-13 native Figma.app capture: File/Agents/Assets/Tools/Variables, no new/removed items. Images are official Figma Help Center attachments (article_attachments CDN), downloaded directly via curl, no auth/login/bot-check involved.
entries.assetDecision: Ground-truth reference of the real application for fidelity work — recreate the surface as closely as possible from it. Logged-in captures may contain the owner's private content; keep those local and use synthetic demo content in tracked surfaces.
